purpose: Non-admission discovery and bounded sample evidence for complementary hail event and multimodal convective datasets.

entries.name: Nixon and Allen extreme hail storm interactions dataset
entries.provider: Nixon and Allen / Central Michigan University
entries.spatial_scope: USA within 90 km of a WSR-88D radar
entries.temporal_scope: Hail subset 2008-2021; combined record has other hazard years
entries.resolution_or_granularity: CSV point reports and surrounding cell characteristics
entries.note: Zenodo API license cc-by-4.0. Bounded original GET on 2026-11-25 https://zenodo.org/records/10672225/files/StormInteractions_HAIL.csv?download=1 yielded 48878 bytes, SHA-256 1f5d061ddee6e721bbf356ede3358dcb667f0cc0fba64991a0df3ff1440cc696 and MD5 2fc284273a32085b35fb0b3d2c4e60a2 matching provider. CSV parsed 331 data rows; observed Date, Time, Radar, Lat, Lon, Mag, SM, Sample, Mode1-4, Orientation, neighboring Cell1-5 at 00/10/20/30 minute offsets and blank spacer columns. Selected >=3 inch hail reports, not representative occurrence sample; do not infer annual rates, treat blank headers explicitly, confirm magnitude units and date/time convention from authors. No original data in Git or database; third-party report lineage and scientific independence require review.

entries.name: NOAA/CIMSS ProbSevere storm-object archive
entries.provider: NOAA / University of Wisconsin CIMSS / Iowa State archive
entries.temporal_scope: V3 operational since August 2025; historic archive availability varies
entries.resolution_or_granularity: GeoJSON storm features, nominal 2 minute cadence; ProbHail, ProbWind, ProbTor
entries.note: Exact bounded GET on 2026-11-25 https://mtarchive.geol.iastate.edu/2025/12/30/mrms/ncep/ProbSevere/MRMS_PROBSEVERE_20251230_000000.json returned 18033 bytes, SHA-256 2c51ef06867fe62c8e7f3c88c0b31d55755ea185cc730a1e4adf587864a5e6c8. JSON parsed 6 features; properties include MaxFED, MaxFCD, MUCAPE, EBSHEAR, MESH, EchoTop_50, VIL, FLASH_RATE, FLASH_DENSITY, WETBULB_0C_HGT, LJA, ProbHail, ID; many values encoded as strings. Provider live directory https://mrms.ncep.noaa.gov/ProbSevere/PROBSEVERE/. Model predicts severe hail >=1 inch, not observed hail or diameter; probabilities and input predictors are dependent. CIMSS product page https://cimss.ssec.wisc.edu/severe_conv/psv3.html displays a reproduction/dissemination restriction; clarify scope and contracted upstream data rights before retention or reuse. No raw data committed or ingested.

entries.name: ProbSevere v3 models and training dataset
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Python pickle model and storm attribute files
entries.note: Live Zenodo metadata 2026-11-25: 7 files, 10760638082 total bytes, cc-by-4.0; hail classifier phv3_lgb_classifier.pkl 7819023 bytes, MD5 9c9b3d34b5bebda73ed0a6f92a4d50bf. Do not deserialize untrusted pickle or execute downloaded models; require trusted isolated conversion to auditable safe format, exact upstream rights review, feature and label definitions. Metadata only; no pickle downloaded.

entries.name: HIToB GOES ABI hail-associated storm polygons Brazil
entries.spatial_scope: Brazil hail reports; GOES-16 South American domain
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 2 km grid infrared cloud objects tracked with TATHU; database file
entries.note: Paper https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11295460/. Live Zenodo API 2026-11-25 returned cc-by-4.0 and HIToB_v1.db 6911950848 bytes, MD5 2ae0f679345d7a97c9e825692359de17. Archive not downloaded due to size; seek bounded subset or author-provided export, do not claim a byte range is a valid SQLite database. Cold cloud threshold 235 K; storms selected by hail association and cloud polygons not actual hail damage swaths. Check report bias, geometry, time and third-party report rights.

entries.name: PyFLEXTRKR global MCS tracking V3
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Hourly 0.1 degree merged IR and IMERG V07B, two MCS definitions
entries.note: Live Zenodo metadata 2026-11-25: 20 files, 29569660540 bytes, cc-by-4.0. Small README 6783 bytes and checksum file 1670 bytes; smallest climatology archive 270842421 bytes. MCS definition requires spatial/temporal persistence and precipitation thresholds; misses small isolated hailstorms, excludes tracks overlapping tropical cyclones, not a hail catalogue. Read README and choose bounded region/month export before full archive acquisition; no source data downloaded.

entries.name: Dong near-global 40-year MCS database
entries.resolution_or_granularity: KFyAO tracked systems from CLAUS and NCEP/CPC brightness temperature, CSV and NetCDF
entries.note: Live Zenodo metadata 2026-11-25: 6 files, 15032621710 bytes, cc-by-4.0; smallest CLAUS_CSVFILE.tar.gz 218241779 bytes. Transition adjustments are latitude/season dependent; check homogeneity and storm definition, avoid double-counting overlapping source years. No direct hail intensity or isolated cell representation. No source bytes downloaded.

entries.name: IPSL TOOCAN tropical deep convective system database
entries.spatial_scope: 40 S to 40 N, five tropical regions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 30 minute lifecycle statistics, regional monthly NetCDF4/ASCII and segmented images
entries.note: Paper https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-16-4021-2024. Provider page https://toocan.ipsl.fr/toocandatabase/2012-2020tropicaltoocandataset/ names CC BY 4.0 with research/publication attribution wording; confirm exact product rights and required acknowledgment before commercial use. DCS cloud shield not hail footprint; misses Germany entirely, useful tropical context only. No original sample.

entries.name: OPERA-SEVIRI-NORDLIS ML/AI fusion dataset
entries.provider: EUMETSAT / EUMETNET / NORDLIS / European Weather Cloud
entries.spatial_scope: European OPERA/SEVIRI overlap; lightning covers Northern Europe
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Co-registered OPERA radar composites, SEVIRI rapid scan radiances and ground lightning in Zarr
entries.note: EWC guide https://confluence.ecmwf.int/spaces/EWCLOUDKB/pages/488063253/Using%2BEUMETSAT%2Bdata%2Bbuckets%2Blocal%2Bdata%2Bpool lists bucket opera-seviri-nordlis.composite.zarr, endpoint https://s3.r1.cloud.eumetsat.int, 2018-2023. EWC-internal credential-free access does not imply public internet access or uniform rights. OPERA data policy https://www.eumetnet.eu/data-access/data-policy/ announces CC BY 4.0 via MeteoGate for qualifying products; SEVIRI and NORDLIS terms must be checked independently. No bucket bytes tested; verify Zarr chunk layout, spatial/time alignment, coverage masks and licensing per layer. Radar composites not necessarily hail size labels. On 2026-11-25 an anonymous HTTPS GET of https://s3.r1.cloud.eumetsat.int/opera-seviri-nordlis.composite.zarr/.zmetadata from authorized macOS returned HTTP 403. This confirms public-internet access was not demonstrated; it does not refute documented EWC-internal availability. Request EWC access and exact layer terms; no Zarr bytes downloaded.
